scripts.backup-all: echo 'Starting comprehensive backup...' && sanity dataset export production ./backups/production-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz && echo 'Production backup completed' && sanity dataset export production ./backups/production-with-drafts-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz --include-drafts && echo 'Production with drafts backup completed' && sanity dataset export staging ./backups/staging-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz && echo 'Staging backup completed' && sanity dataset export staging ./backups/staging-with-drafts-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz --include-drafts && echo 'Staging with drafts backup completed' && echo 'All backups completed successfully!'
